# References {.unnumbered}

The bibliography links to primary papers and publisher records. Publication
status is recorded at the literature cutoff of 20 October 2026; preprints may
subsequently change. The [literature guide](c-literature-guide.qmd) explains
which sources support which parts of the book. We use $k$ for moment order
in the text; some paper titles use $t$ for design order.
